build_audio_text_video_embedding: build an AudioTextVideoEmbedding module to fuse audio, text, and video into joint embeddings using Haiku
create_embedding_module: create an EmbeddingModule with linear or MLP projection heads to map features to a fixed embedding dimension
build_visual_module: build a VisualModule using S3D or TSM-ResNet backbones to extract video features from image tensors
create_audio_module: create an AudioModule with a ResNet backbone to extract audio features from spectrogram tensors
build_text_module: build a TextModule that computes sentence representations from word IDs using embeddings and Conv1D max pooling
